subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Science-Based Targets
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Science-Based Targets.

hook.text: A company pledges to cut emissions 42% by 2030. That number isn't arbitrary—it's what climate science requires.

buildup.text: Science-based targets (SBTs) align corporate emission reduction goals with what's needed to limit warming.

discovery.text: The SBTi validates targets to ensure they're consistent with the Paris Agreement's 1.5°C pathway.

twist.text: Setting the target is easy. Achieving it requires transforming supply chains—new suppliers, new energy, new processes.

climax.text: Over 4,000 companies have SBTi-approved targets. Supply chain emissions are a required part of the commitment.

punchline.text: Targets backed by science carry credibility targets alone can't.

quiz.question: What does the SBTi validate?
options: Emission reduction targets aligned with climate science
